dataset_name: Image Dataset for Turmeric Plant Leaf Disease Detection (Dataset 01 / Primary)
available_classes: Aphids Disease (221), Blotch (238), Leaf Spot (193), Healthy Leaf (213)
capture_conditions: Outdoor spice field conditions, smartphone camera, isolated single leaf focus
decision_notes: Primary development source. Internal validation/test sets derived from this dataset. Cannot serve as external validation.

dataset_name: Turmeric Plant Disease Dataset (Dataset 02 / External Field Benchmark)
available_classes: Healthy Leaf (197), Leaf Blotch (199), Dry Leaf (203), Rhizome Disease Roots (182), Rhizome Healthy Roots (282)
capture_conditions: Outdoor plantation field conditions, 4000x3000 high-res camera, ambient sunlight, soil/canopy background
decision_notes: Verified independent geographic region (Jamalpur vs Pabna) with zero image overlap. Suitable for field domain-shift stress testing.

dataset_name: PhilMedic: Philippine Medicinal Plant Leaf Dataset
available_classes: Curcuma longa (Class 15: Turmeric / Luyang Dilaw) among 40 medicinal plant species
capture_conditions: Natural ambient daylight, 48-MP smartphone, front and back of detached leaves
decision_notes: Independent botanical species identification dataset from Philippines. Useful as non-pathology healthy reference.
